# CANDIDATE: STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND

## Hypothesis

The STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND candidate hypothesizes that vetting the direction of the trend relative to the market structure can improve the overall performance of the trading system by removing wrong-way trades.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves wiring the `crypto.lib.market_structure.classify_trend` function into the entry path to block P-in-uptrend and C-in-downtrend trades. The veto is pure, removing only wrong-way trades without affecting winners.
